name: RenderAnimatedSize
coverage: switchers__animated_size_retarget checks the outer size per frame; a mid-flight target change diverges one frame late (switchers-002). switchers__animated_size_top_left_alignment matches the child placement at topLeft. Clip and reverse run are not separately checked (reverse: switchers-004).

name: RenderAnimatedSizeState
coverage: The layout-time state machine (Start, Stable, Changed, Unstable in animated_size.rs:128-175) is observed through the retarget scenario (switchers-002) and through the cross-fade scenario, whose outer size lags one frame (switchers-001).

name: AnimatedCrossFade
coverage: switchers__cross_fade_reversed_different_sizes reverses mid-animation between children of 90x40 and 150x76. The outgoing child now takes the stack width (150) at the same frame as Flutter. The outer size adopts the new child size one frame late (switchers-001), with a 30 px horizontal shift of the child for that frame. Not checked: focus exclusion, semantics exclusion, layoutBuilder, reverseDuration.

name: AnimatedGrid
coverage: Insertion at index 1 with a 300 ms SizeTransition matches (switchers__animated_grid_insert_size_transition). Removal, removed item builder, index shift on removal and removeAllItems are not frame-tested; Incular has remove_at_with_builder and remove_all_with_builder (advanced_slivers/animated.rs:356-420) with the same API shape, reading only.

name: AnimatedGridState
coverage: Private State class of AnimatedGrid. Observable behavior is attributed to the AnimatedGrid row; Incular has no matching public state type.

name: AnimatedList
coverage: Insertion at index 1 matches (switchers__animated_list_insert_size_transition). Removal with a removed item builder matches the outgoing size and the index shift of the remaining items for all 24 frames (switchers__animated_list_remove_shifts_items). The removed item stays one frame at zero size in Incular (switchers-007). removeAllItems not frame-tested (reading: remove_all at advanced_slivers/animated.rs:407-420).

name: AnimatedListState
coverage: Private State class of AnimatedList. Observable behavior is attributed to the AnimatedList row.

name: SliverAnimatedGrid
coverage: Insertion at index 1 with a 300 ms SizeTransition matches (switchers__sliver_animated_grid_insert_size_transition). Removal and rapid repeated mutations not frame-tested.

name: SliverAnimatedGridState
coverage: Private State class of SliverAnimatedGrid. Observable behavior is attributed to the SliverAnimatedGrid row.

name: SliverAnimatedList
coverage: Initial two-row layout matches (switchers__sliver_animated_list_initial_layout). Insertion and removal are not frame-tested: the Incular controller exposes insert(index) and insert_at(index, now) (sliver_lists.rs:678-700) with the animation private to the entry, so a fake-clock twin needs a harness capability (see Harness requests). The item builder receives no animation (switchers-006).

name: SliverAnimatedListState
coverage: Private State class of SliverAnimatedList. Observable behavior is attributed to the SliverAnimatedList row.

name: AnimatedSize
coverage: Duration, curve, alignment (center and topLeft) and retarget checked by switchers__animated_size_retarget and switchers__animated_size_top_left_alignment; the retarget diverges one frame late (switchers-002). reverseDuration is absent (switchers-004). clipBehavior is only set in the twin, not separately observed.

name: AnimatedSwitcher
coverage: Overlapping rapid switches (switchers__switcher_overlapping_children); same key with changed content does not transition (switchers__switcher_same_key_no_transition, matches); reverseDuration for the outgoing child (switchers__switcher_reverse_duration, matches); custom layoutBuilder (switchers__switcher_layout_builder_top_left, matches). transitionBuilder receives f32, not Animation<double> (switchers-003). Default builder matches.

name: AnimatedModalBarrier
coverage: switchers__animated_modal_barrier_color_and_dismiss: animated color between two non-null colors and the dismiss callback match over 27 frames. Nullable color animation unavailable (switchers-005). Semantic actions not in the recorder.
